name: That Friday Again
source: Medieval Europe. With dark humor, pagan gods, and endless Fridays. You are a former king. Having quarreled with the gods, you lost everything and are stuck in a curse. From now on, you are forced to live the same day forever. Everything depends on your actions. Can you break the curse?
translation: 中世纪的欧洲。黑色幽默、异教诸神和无尽的星期五。你是前国王。与诸神争吵后，你失去了一切，并陷入了诅咒。从现在开始，你将被迫永远过同一天。一切都取决于你的行动。你能打破诅咒吗？
